title: Decide cppcheck scan scope: apps/ and tests/ are unscanned (spec R-APPC-011 command says lichen/)
description: Follow-up from worker6-b7z9.48 (suppressions wiring). Spec appendix-c R-APPC-011 gives the mandatory cppcheck command over 'lichen/', but both runners (.github/workflows/ci.yml and scripts/lint-c.sh) scan only lichen/subsys+lib+drivers — lichen/apps/ (incl. the 3 known macro-heavy syntaxError files already listed in lichen/.cppcheck-suppressions) and lichen/tests/ are excluded. Either (a) expand both runners to full lichen/ scope and keep the curated suppressions (the file already carries the apps/gateway syntaxError entries and tests/* comparePointers entries, suggesting expansion was anticipated), or (b) amend the spec text to the reduced scope with rationale. Note: the curated suppressions file was written for bead lora_ipv6_mesh-2mla with a ratchet plan ('tighten by deleting lines here'); any scope expansion should re-baseline that file in the same change.
